general.description:
Nested in orbit of one of the goldylocks planets of the Teegarden System, Garden Center is a florishing smuggling Station. Litterally, as it was created by a group of passionates botanists.
Sometimes, they accepts payment in seeds and cutting of rare plants, to complete their vast collection of flora from all the known universe.
general.bar: Visitors taking a tee in the space Garden in the hall of the Garden center, in the System of Teegarden.
